summary: Library: four views (전체/요약/썸네일/그리드, one GridView, LibraryGridMath), paged lists (ListPager + pager bar, no fast scroller; measured LIST/COMPACT, fixed-row grids), cover prefetch, no-query view switch, polish 14 cards, drawer 독서 노트·단어장 with lazy counts, book menu 독서 노트, notes-aware delete/empty-trash, trash 파일 없음, C35 onCreate order with restoreIfStale + probeAsync after first list, idle 10 s auto backup (AutoBackup.schedule), AutoRestorePrompt with scan hold, 다른 백업 보기, late-answer line, one-time status line.
checks: module typecheck OK; module unittest OK (72 tests); full typecheck OK; full unittest OK (1208 tests). Two reviewer passes (spec + bugs); all findings fixed; no re-review after fixes.
contractRequests: res: drawables ic_view_agenda (전체) and ic_apps (그리드) from library.md §2.2 do not exist; ic_article / ic_grid_view are used.
rcaNotes: None required: the library wires everything itself. Depends on DA-C (AutoBackup.isDue/schedule/findCandidates/pickDefault/restore/lastWrittenAt/locationLabel, InstallState.ensure/offerPending/settleOffer), DA-N (Notes.drawerCounts/countForBooks), RU (DeviceLight.restoreIfStale) implementations.
deviations: Trash book menu keeps 책 정보: 복원 · 책 정보 · 독서 노트 · 영구 삭제 (N §10.1 lists 복원 · 독서 노트 · 영구 삭제).
Book menu 독서 노트 follows 책 정보 (spec's '문서 속성'; CI looks for 책 정보).
Paged mode reserves the status strip's height as list padding (not a pure overlay) so no row under it counts as seen; the 2-line backup notice reserves 56 dp.
A candidate-search IO failure leaves the offer pending (asked next visit) instead of settling it.
Idle backup uses AutoBackup.schedule(ctx,0){busy} (runs runNow on the backup thread, single-flight) per S §3.2; busy() reports user activity as LIB.md asks.
GRID and COVERS share the ic_grid_view toolbar icon; LIST uses ic_article (new drawables absent).
